hero.title: Lockdile
hero.subtitle: 와악어
hero.tagline: Step away without locking, and a crocodile bites the intruder's cursor — then locks your Mac.
hero.subtagline: A menu-bar crocodile that guards your unlocked Mac. Free & open source.

steps.title: Arm it
steps.desc: Hit the menu-bar 🐊 or press ⌃⌥G when you leave your desk.

steps.title: Detect
steps.desc: The moment someone types, it strikes. (The mouse is ignored.)

steps.title: Chomp & lock
steps.desc: The crocodile lunges at the cursor and locks the screen.

download.title: Download Lockdile
download.subtitle: For macOS (Apple Silicon). Free & open source.
firstrun: Open the .dmg and drag the app into Applications
Right-click the app → Open → Open (Gatekeeper warns since it isn't notarized yet)
System Settings → Privacy & Security → enable lockdile under Accessibility + Input Monitoring, then relaunch
